This draft is fine to publish as written.

- **Disclosure:** The link is marked "(Affiliate link)" right beside it, which is what section 4 requires. Nothing in the draft says the tea was gifted or that this is a paid partnership, so no "Ad" or "Gifted" opener is needed. If Pebblebrook sent the reviewer free product, the post would need to start with "Gifted", so confirm that with them.
- **Claims:** "Easiest to pause" is the reviewer's own opinion from their own experience, and it fits our allowed claim that subscribers can pause or cancel any time. It isn't a "best" or "number one" claim. "The tins are lovely" is also personal opinion. There are no health, environmental, guarantee, urgency or invented-number claims.
- **Voice:** It is plain and warm, with no banned phrases.

As with all public content, Sam needs to approve it before it goes live.
